newsitem.title: UK: Kwik Save falls as profits are downgraded.
newsitem.headline: Kwik Save falls as profits are downgraded.

text.p: Shares in British food retailer Kwik Save Plc slid further on Thursday as the market took in a profits downgrades and expectations of exceptional restructuring costs made by analyst Paul Smiddy at Credit Lyonnais Laing.
Kwik Save shares were down 15-1/2 pence at 326 pence by 0935 GMT after falling 25 pence on Wednesday, below their previous year low of 345 pence.
Smiddy said he was downgrading profit forecasts for this year to 81 million stg from 86 million stg previously, with around 65 million stg more in exceptionals expected.
For next year, he said he had downgraded profits to 74 million stg from 80 million stg previously.

Smiddy's comments came as Kwik Save undergoes a strategic review aimed at solving its problems as it is squeezed both by the major supermarkets, Tesco, J. Sainsbury, ASDA and Safeway, and by discounters.
